svg.title: Successively spin-cast PbS and EDT solution
svg.desc: Successively spin-cast PbS and EDT solution. Rotation speed: 2500 rpm Total repeated treatment count: 3 cycles Environment: Not reported; Atmosphere not reported for this operation. Source says process repeated three times. No extra fourth cycle inferred; effective PbS layer approximately280nm. EDT emulates the hot-injection comparator treatment and passivates traps according to authors. Conceptual material flow. Shapes do not represent apparatus geometry, liquid levels or measured particle structure.
